title: The Hidden Algorithm That Decides Which of You Survives a Car Crash

why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into deep fear of being betrayed by technology you trust — people will argue about ethics in comments.

title: The Hidden Global Map That Shows Every Place Where Magnets Don't Work

title: The Hidden Bunker Where Scientists Kept a Man Alive for 30 Days Without Light

title: Why a Single Beach in Iceland Has Black Sand Made of Crushed Volcanoes

title: The Experiment That Made a Monkey Choose to Electrocute Itself
hook: In a 1960s study, monkeys pressed a lever for food even when it delivered a shock — but one monkey chose starvation over pain.
why_this_can_go_viral: Dark and ethically questionable — viewers will debate the morality and the psychology.

title: The Secret Vault Under a Swiss Mountain That Stores Every Human Smile Ever Recorded

title: The Hidden Time Capsule That Contains a Message From a Dead Civilization That Never Existed
hook: An underground capsule in Nevada holds a language no one speaks — invented by a group that vanished without a trace.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mystery layered on mystery — a language from a group that never existed is pure clickbait gold.

title: Why a Single Factory in Japan Has Been Making the Same Screw Since 1898

hook: A endurance artist forced his eyelids open with tape for a full day — and his corneas started to crack like dry mud.

title: The Experiment That Made a Dog Refuse to Leave a Room That Was Electrified

title: Why a Single Mountain in Bolivia Has a Lake 4 Miles Above Sea Level
